analysis.summary: Management reported a strong performance in Q1 FY27 with healthy revenue and profitability growth driven by scalability, new branch expansion, and traditional business execution. The company is confident in achieving its revised FY27 revenue guidance of INR325 crores to INR350 crores and maintaining a PAT margin of 9% to 11%. AkikoPay's development is complete, with apps live on Android and iOS, and integration for insurance and mutual funds expected in the next quarter. Additionally, management highlighted strong core momentum, a comfortable debt and funding position requiring no equity raise for the next year, and a long-term CAGR target of 70% to 100% over the next 3 years. Akiko Global Services Limited released its investor presentation for Q1 FY27, highlighting robust operational scale across credit card sourcing and loan disbursements alongside the rollout of the upgraded Android version of AkikoPay.

guidance.claim: Management revised the FY27 revenue guidance to INR325 crores to INR350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management is confident of delivering a PAT margin of 9% to 11% for the year.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management projects a CAGR of 70% to 100% year-on-year basis over the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: Management expects 70% to 100% revenue growth for FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: The company targets INR1,000 crores in revenue by 2030.
guidance.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 revenue between INR65 crores and INR70 crores.
guidance.quote: I am expecting INR65 crores to something in between crores in Q1.

guidance.claim: Management targets INR50 crores in revenue from AkikoPay in FY27.
guidance.quote: In FY27, I am expecting around INR50 crores revenue from AkikoPay.

guidance.claim: Management targets an unsecured loan book of INR1,000 crores by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book.

guidance.claim: Management expects total revenue of over INR300 crores for FY27.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores. That is not going below INR300 crores, this is going to be above INR300 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: The sourcing pipeline is healthy, providing good visibility for upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loan is currently the fastest-growing loan product.
Credit card penetration in India remains relatively low at approximately 7-8% of the population.
demand_outlook.quote: Credit card penetration remains relatively low at ~7-8% of the population, indicating significant headroom for expansion compared to global benchmarks.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the initial response to AkikoPay has been encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The initial response to AkikoPay has been very encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that physical presence in a city increases lead conversion rates from 10% to between 60% and 80%.
demand_outlook.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has 25 branches across 19 cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to open new branches in Indore and Kerala over the next 2-3 months.
capex_expansion.quote: Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: There is a total planned target of 25 branches for the year.
capex_expansion.quote: There is a plan for 25 branches in total.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its company-owned branch presence in multiple cities including Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bangalore, and others.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities. Like Delhi NCR is known to everyone, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Lucknow, Kolkata, Patna, and many emerging markets.

capex_expansion.claim: AkikoPay has recorded over 50,000 Android downloads.
capex_expansion.quote: So far, we have done some 50,000+ Android downloads, and we have negligible cost on that.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has increased its branch count from 3 or 4 to 16 across India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

margins_costs.claim: Unsecured loan disbursements yield an average payout of 3.10%.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: The company focuses on profitability and is not burning money in initial years unlike other fintechs.
margins_costs.quote: Unlike other fintechs that burn money in their initial years, we are not focusing on losing money at all because our offline business, our core business, and our distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 14.8%.
The PAT margin for Q1 FY27 was reported at 10.3%.
Total expenditure on building AkikoPay technology so far has been around INR1 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Not much, around INR1 crores in total so far on building technology etc, that is it. Nothing more.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently has a team strength of around 950 employees.
orders_capacity.quote: In the investor deck, it has been mentioned that the employee strength is around odd 950.

orders_capacity.claim: Employee strength is distributed among 16 people in tech, about 700 in sales, about 50 in backend, and management staff.
orders_capacity.quote: Sure. Absolutely. Look, currently on the tech side, we have a total of 16 people -- 16 people on the tech side. On the sales side, we have odd 700 people. On the backend side, we have odd 50 people. And the rest are our management staff.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals increased to over ₹450 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards.
The company successfully disburses 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.
orders_capacity.quote: If we talk about the credit card segment, which used to be our core business at one time, today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

orders_capacity.claim: The monthly loan disbursement run rate has reached INR400 crores plus, representing an annualized book of INR5,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

orders_capacity.claim: The combined workforce including employees and channel partners has crossed 900+.
orders_capacity.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

orders_capacity.claim: The unsecured loan book stands at INR320 crores and the secured book at INR80 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Unsecured book is INR320 crores, rest is secured book.

capital_allocation.claim: There are no plans for fundraising for the next 6 months to 1 year.
capital_allocation.quote: So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year. That means there is no plan until then.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dubai business revenue was impacted by war pressure in the first quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dubai operations experienced temporary margin pressure due to geopolitical issues around the Iran region.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the Android version of AkikoPay will be implemented on Apple's App Store within a week.
management_commitments.quote: Customers are also really liking our new Android version and this same version will be implemented on Apple's App Store within a week.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to build engagement with customers over the next 1-2 years so they open AkikoPay for credit cards.
management_commitments.quote: So we want to build that engagement over the next 1-2 years with all those customers.

management_commitments.claim: PAT margin could increase to 12% to 14% next year if AkikoPay performs very well.
management_commitments.quote: If AkikoPay works very well, next year that will go up to 12% to 14%.

management_commitments.claim: Upper management positions such as CEO will be filled over the next 2 to 3 months.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next 2 months -- 3 months, as you mentioned, those positions will be filled.

management_commitments.claim: Integration of insurance and mutual funds into AkikoPay will begin and take 2 months.
management_commitments.quote: After that version, our integration of insurance and mutual funds will begin. That will take 2 months.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that AkikoPay will most likely be live on iOS within the month of May 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Now compliance has also been completed, so most likely within this month, everything will be live.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that everything in the AkikoPay ecosystem will most likely be seen within the next quarter.
management_commitments.quote: So most likely within the next quarter, you will see everything in one ecosystem.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to take the CEO or MD position in the next one or two months.
management_commitments.quote: Most likely in the next one or two months. I have already spoken with my management. They did agreed. So, we'll take a -- we'll take a decision very soon and in the next quarter, you will see me as an MD.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching 5 lakh customers on AkikoPay by 30th September.
management_commitments.quote: I am expecting 5 lakh customers by 30th of September and 1 million customers till 31st December.

management_commitments.claim: Mutual funds and insurance products are expected to go live by August onwards.
management_commitments.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
